skill.name: telegram-mini-app
skill.description: Build Telegram Mini Apps with Web App APIs, TON Connect, payments, authentication, native interface patterns, referrals, and performance guidance.
skill.summary: Design secure Telegram Mini Apps with TON integrations and native Telegram experiences.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: All 17 static findings are false positives caused by documentation examples, JavaScript template literals, standard code splitting, placeholder URLs, and legitimate server-side environment access. Semantic review found that the initData validation example omits freshness and replay checks.

remediation.issue: The initData validation example verifies the signature but does not reject stale auth_date values or replayed payloads.
remediation.suggestion: Add an auth_date age limit and application-level replay protection before accepting authenticated actions.

content.value_statement: Telegram Mini Apps require platform-specific authentication, interface, wallet, and payment patterns. This skill provides implementation guidance for Telegram Web Apps and TON integrations.
actual_capabilities: Creates Telegram Web App setup patterns for HTML and React.
Provides TON Connect wallet and transaction integration guidance.
Designs Telegram Stars invoices and referral sharing flows.
Applies Telegram theme, button, haptic, and mobile interface conventions.
Reviews Mini App performance, loading, and mobile wallet behavior.
limitations: Does not deploy applications, bots, or smart contracts.
Does not replace security testing or a smart contract audit.
Requires project-specific bot tokens, domains, wallet addresses, and payment rules.
Authentication guidance needs added freshness and replay checks.

use_cases.title: Launch a Telegram Service
use_cases.description: Plan a Telegram-native application with authentication, bot entry points, responsive interface patterns, and deployment requirements.

use_cases.title: Add TON Payments
use_cases.description: Integrate TON Connect, transaction confirmation, mobile wallet behavior, and manifest configuration into an existing React application.

use_cases.title: Review Mini App Security
use_cases.description: Check initData validation, client trust boundaries, payment flows, mobile testing, and Telegram platform requirements before release.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Starter App
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a React Telegram Mini App starter with theme support, MainButton integration, loading states, and a clear server authentication boundary.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Telegram Users
prompt_templates.prompt: Design Node.js initData validation with signature verification, constant-time comparison, auth_date expiration, replay prevention, and safe error handling.

prompt_templates.title: Integrate TON Connect
prompt_templates.prompt: Add TON Connect to my React Mini App with a manifest, wallet status handling, mobile deep links, transaction review, and failure recovery.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Release
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Telegram Mini App architecture for authentication, payment integrity, platform interface compliance, performance, mobile behavior, and deployment risks.

output_examples.input: Plan authentication for a Telegram Mini App backend.
output: Validate signed initData on the server.
Reject expired auth_date values and replayed payloads.
Keep the bot token outside client code.
Create application sessions only after validation.

output_examples.input: Review my TON Connect payment experience.
output: Show the destination and amount before wallet confirmation.
Handle connection changes and rejected transactions.
Test return flows on iOS and Android.

output_examples.input: Improve a slow Telegram Mini App.
output_examples.output: Reduce the initial bundle, lazy-load heavy views, show an immediate loading state, optimize images, and test inside Telegram on real devices.

best_practices: Validate Telegram initData on the server before trusting user identity or authorizing actions.
Use Telegram theme variables and native controls for consistent behavior.
Test wallet, payment, and navigation flows on real iOS and Android devices.
anti_patterns: Do not trust initDataUnsafe for server authorization.
Do not place bot tokens, signing secrets, or private keys in client code.
Do not submit wallet transactions without displaying destination, amount, and failure states.

faq.question: What frameworks does this skill support?
faq.answer: It provides general web patterns and detailed React examples for Telegram Web Apps.

faq.question: Does it support TON wallets?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers TON Connect providers, manifests, wallet state, mobile behavior, and transaction requests.

faq.question: Can it implement Telegram Stars payments?
faq.answer: It provides bot invoice patterns for Telegram Stars, but application-specific fulfillment and payment verification remain required.

faq.question: Is initDataUnsafe suitable for authentication?
faq.answer: No. Use it only for untrusted interface display, then validate initData on a trusted server.

faq.question: Does the skill deploy the application?
faq.answer: No. It can prepare architecture and implementation guidance, but hosting, bot configuration, secrets, and releases remain project responsibilities.

faq.question: What testing is still required?
faq.answer: Test authentication, replay resistance, payments, wallet recovery, themes, navigation, and performance inside Telegram on real mobile devices.
